reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_mcp** (confidence high). Mercado Libre (incl. TuCarro) has a documented OAuth REST API (items, vehicle classifieds publishing, search with restrictions) and an official remote MCP server (mainly devsite/docs tooling).

official_mcp.name: Mercado Libre MCP Server
official_mcp.note: Official remote MCP (Authorization: Bearer <app access token>); docs https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/mcp-server

sandbox.notes: Mercado Libre has no sandbox: 'We do not have a test environment or sandbox to run tests: we make it possible to use test users for verification directly in production.' Create up to 10 test users with POST https://api.mercadolibre.com/users/test_user {site_id} using a production access token, save their credentials at once (they cannot be listed later), and authorize the app as a test seller; test users only transact with other test users' listings and expire after a while.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent of any Mercado Libre account to your app (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/mercadolibre.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Do not share one refresh token between this server and the ecommerce/marketplaces Mercado Libre servers.

adapter.terms: Mercado Libre developer terms; one app and token work across sites (MLA Argentina, MLB Brazil, MLM Mexico, MCO Colombia/TuCarro …). Prices in the item's currency_id.

me.note: GET /users/me returns the authorised user {id, nickname, site_id, country_id, ...}.

get_listing.note: GET /items/{item_id} with a Bearer token (vehicle example MLB1045563828, category MLB1744 in 'List vehicles'): works for any site, since the id carries the site prefix (MLA…, MLB…, MLM…, MCO…). Vehicle attributes (BRAND, MODEL, VEHICLE_YEAR, KILOMETERS …), location and pictures stay in raw.attributes / raw.location / raw.pictures.

not_offered.search_listings: Items & Searches (updated 04/04/2025) documents /sites/{site_id}/search only by seller_id/nickname and replaces it with /users/{id}/items/search (the caller's own items); no keyword or category listing search is documented, so none is served.
not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN decoder in the Mercado Libre API.
not_offered.get_valuation: No valuation endpoint in the Mercado Libre API.
not_offered.list_dealers: No dealer directory endpoint in the Mercado Libre API.

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
token api.mercadolibre.com/oauth/token: 400 invalid client_id or client_secret
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
